'''2000 Victorian State Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG state championship held in Victoria, Australia in May 2000. [[Michael Josem]] won it. It is known from Ryan Fojtik's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d776">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-21-milwaukee-wi-5-20-00d776/ milwaukee-wi-5-20-00], DeckTech (Ryan "XjedeyeX" Fojtik, 21 May 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-21-milwaukee-wi-5-20-00d776/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' May 2000
* '''Site:''' Victoria, Australia
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Michael Josem]]
